name: FutBar
author: devbook
description: Live match center and football tracker with tactical lineups, real-time scores, league tables, and live event alerts.

barWidget.description: Compact top-bar football widget with real-time match tracking, tactical pitch lineups, live commentary, standings, and desktop event alerts.

schema.label: Team name
schema.description: Use the name shown by ESPN, for example Barcelona or Arsenal.

schema.label: ESPN league code
schema.description: Examples: esp.1 (LaLiga), eng.1 (Premier League), ita.1 (Serie A), ger.1 (Bundesliga), uefa.champions.

schema.label: ESPN team ID
schema.description: Numeric ESPN team identifier, resolved automatically when you pick a club in the panel. Rarely needs manual editing.

schema.label: Tab label style
schema.description: Choose how followed tabs are labeled: abbrev (3 letters), short (short names), or full (full names).

schema.label: Bar widget display mode
schema.description: Choose what is displayed on the top bar: icon (minimal glyph), score (live match score), or next (upcoming fixture).

schema.label: Kickoff time format
schema.description: Format for match kickoff times: 24h (20:00), 12h (8:00 PM), or relative (in 2h 15m).

schema.label: Enable desktop notifications
schema.description: Master switch to enable or disable all desktop match notifications.

schema.label: Goal alerts
schema.description: Send desktop notification when a goal is scored.

schema.label: Cards and match whistles
schema.description: Send desktop notification on red cards, penalties, kickoff, and full-time.

schema.label: Notification scope
schema.description: Choose whether to receive alerts for primary club only or all followed tabs.

schema.label: Anti-spoiler mode
schema.description: Hide match scores behind a reveal badge until hovered or clicked.

schema.label: Show pre-match betting odds
schema.description: Show pre-match betting odds and win probability in fixture info.

schema.label: Live polling interval (seconds)
schema.description: Refresh rate during live matches: 10, 30, or 60 seconds.
